hints.title: Max Bottleneck Exploration
hints.text: To keep the minimum path value as large as possible, always pick the neighbor with the largest available grid value to visit next.

hints.title: Frontier Priority Order
hints.text: A collection prioritizing largest values will guide traversal greedily across 4-directional grid cells.

hints.title: Cumulative Bottleneck Tracking
hints.text: Maintain running minimum value along the active path. The instant the destination cell is popped from the frontier, its score is the maximum achievable.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded path searches branch exponentially across grid cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Max-priority queue exploration ensures the first arrival at the bottom-right corner carries the optimal bottleneck value.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as modified Dijkstra or maximum bottleneck spanning tree problem.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved using Disjoint Set Union by adding cells in descending order of value.
